item.title: After the AI Prompt: What Comes Next
item.description: AI is evolving quickly, but most conversations are still focused on prompts, tools, and surface-level use cases. This event is about what comes next. ​We are bringing together founders, engineers, and builders who are working directly with generative AI in real-world settings from building companies to designing systems to deploying models. Instead of focusing on what AI could do, this event focuses on what is actually happening now.

item.title: Agent Skills Foundations, Best Practices, and a Hands-On Workshop
item.description: Discover how agent skills make AI more useful, reliable, and focused. This Learn & Build workshop starts with a clear introduction to agent skill foundations, then moves into a hands-on session where you’ll use Claude to create your own skill. Ideal for non-developers, product professionals, and anyone who wants to build practical AI workflows.

item.title: An Overview of AI Dev Agents for Non-Developers
item.description:
Get a deep-dive into AI development agents designed for professionals who work alongside development teams but don’t write code daily. This session explains how specialized AI agents are changing software development workflows and what technical leaders need to know about this emerging technology.

You’ll learn:

  • How AI development agents differ from general AI tools
  • The architecture behind sub-agent systems:
    • Context isolation
    • Specialization
    • Coordination patterns: parallel vs. sequential
    • Communication with orchestration agent
  • Real-world use cases: code analysis, security auditing, testing automation
  • Sub-Agent examples in Claude Code
    • How to create them
    • How to use them

item.title: An Overview of Cody Framework and Spec Driven Development
item.description: Marcelo Lewin gives a full presentation at the Tech Showcase Fall 2025 Lightning Talks, hosted by Tech Link Up, on Spec Driven Development and a demo of the Cody Product Builder, a spec-driven development AI agent skill that helps product builders using vibe coding techniques bring their ideas to life.

item.title: Building AI Skills Without Code: Designing Workflow-Driven Agents for Non-Developers
item.description: In this presentation, you’ll learn how to turn repeatable workflows into reusable AI skills, modular instruction sets that guide AI through multi-step tasks. Designed for product managers, content creators, and business professionals, you’ll learn a practical framework and see a simple AI skill built live from scratch.

item.title: Building Marketing Tools at the Speed of Vibes
item.description: Learn how to apply Vibe Coding techniques with platforms like Lovable to rapidly prototype and launch marketing apps.

item.title: From Vibe Coding to Shippable App at Planet Cyber Sec
item.description:
In this online presentation at the Planet Cyber Security Conference, I focus on how to vibe code in a structured way using Spec Driven Development to deliver a scalable and maintainable app.

Agenda:

  • What is vibe coding, and how is it different from AI-assisted engineering?
  • How good at coding should you be to vibe code?
  • Why vibe coding doesn’t always deliver what you want
  • Why the SDLC still matters, even when you’re moving fast
  • An overview of spec driven development and frameworks
  • Vibe coding tips and best practices

item.title: From Vibe Coding to Shippable Solution + Vibe Coding Session
item.description: Learn how to go from a demo app to a shippable solution using structured documentation frameworks.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Dev Days Los Angeles
item.description: Learn how agent skills, GitHub Copilot, and practical AI-assisted development workflows can help developers and builders create more structured, reusable, and effective AI-powered software experiences.

item.title: How to Publish your Vibe Coded App for Others To Use
item.description: Explore how to take your vibe-coded app from your laptop to the real world. You’ll learn the key steps for publishing with confidence—choosing the right hosting, and more.

item.title: I Build with AI Buildathon: From Idea to Demo
item.description: Turn your idea into a demo at the I Build with AI Buildathon. Bring a laptop and your favorite AI tool for a hands-on night of building, support, pizza, and prizes.

item.title: Intro to Agent Skills at Cal Poly Pomona AI Fair & Hackathon
item.description: A practical session at the Cal Poly Pomona AI Fair & Hackathon 2026 introducing the emerging concept of agent skills, a simple, open format for giving AI agents new capabilities, domain expertise, and repeatable workflows.

item.title: Intro to Vibe Coding with Amazon Kiro Demo
item.description: Get a solid intro to vibe coding and how to structure your sessions for better AI-assisted results.

item.title: Multi-Agent Vibe Coding for Better Results
item.description: Learn the essentials of multi-agent vibe coding, what agents and subagents are, how parallel vs. serialized setups work, and why this approach delivers smarter, more reliable results.

item.title: OpenClaw 101: Practical AI, Smarter Workflows, and Secure Setup
item.description: Discover how OpenClaw helps knowledge workers and domain experts move beyond basic AI chat tools into smarter, more integrated workflows. This introductory session covers what OpenClaw is, how to install and configure it, and how to secure it properly using least-privilege best practices so you can get the benefits of practical AI without unnecessary risk.

item.title: Prototype Driven Development: Keep Your Plan Flexible as You Build with AI
item.description: In this presentation, I’ll introduce Prototype Driven Development (PDD), a way of building where you keep your plan but hold it loosely, spinning off fast, throwaway prototypes to answer the decisions you can’t make on paper, then folding what you learn back into the plan.

item.title: Structured Vibe Coding Without Losing the Vibes
item.description:
​In today’s fast-paced solo-dev world, vibe coding lets you brainstorm, prototype, and spin up MVPs or proofs of concept in minutes with no heavy processes required.

​But moving straight from an idea to AI-generated code can mean skipping vital steps like clarifying goals, defining scope, and capturing intent.

​In this session, we’ll:

  • ​Define vibe coding and how it differs from more traditional AI-assisted engineering.
  • ​Walk through a lightweight framework—PRDs, feature plans, task breakdown, that channels your creative spark into organized artifacts.
  • ​See real examples of how structure improves AI output.
  • ​Build a small app live, so you can experience the flow from idea to structured code in real time.

item.title: Turn Your Domain Expertise into a Mobile App with AI
item.description: Learn how domain experts and non-developers can turn their expertise into a mobile app using AI. This presentation and hands-on workshop introduces vibe coding through a real example, showing how intent and domain knowledge shape AI-powered apps.

item.title: Turning UX into Apps at the Speed of Vibes
item.description: Discover how AI-assisted vibe coding turns UX designs into functional apps at lightning speed using tools like Figma MCP, design systems, and Microsoft Copilot.

item.title: Unlocking the Strategic Mindset of AI + Quick Intro to Agent Skills
item.description: In this session, Sharad Aggarwal, Global Head of Strategy & AI Solutions at Google Cloud, breaks down how non-technical professionals can think strategically about AI, without needing to code.

item.title: Vibe Coding with Intent for Better and Faster Results
item.description: Learn how to express intent in your vibe coding through structured documentation frameworks.
